Name: Emerald Acre Farm
Author: RiftstalkerSekun
Description:
A nice, peaceful little farm map. Condensed and cozy, with four paddocks with permanent fencing capable of holding 15 basic Iridium Sprinklers each and a small hill top for buildings. All paddock entrances and exits have invisible tiles to keep animals from wandering outside the given paddock. Upgrade your tools to access more of the paddocks, or keep things extra cozy and only use a few, the power is yours!
Other features include a small yard for early machines next to the house, and a dedicated spot for teleportation obelisks. And a waterfall, because who doesn't like waterfalls? All grass and dirt spots are tillable and plantable.

This map DOES NOT REPLACE any other farm map, and is its own unique, custom map. 

The fencing is permanent, will not decay, and is not removable. This is a feature, not a bug.

Love the cute map, but want more space to grow crops? Maybe you'd be interested in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28253]some buildable greenhouses?[/url]﻿ 
Crops pictured in the sample layout image are a combination of base game crops and crops from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28053]Crop Expansion mod.[/url]﻿ If you want just a little handful more variety in what you can grow that's also balanced against the base game's crops, give it a try!
